frontmatter.name: excel-converter
frontmatter.description: Converts manually filled "9 points" Excel measurement sheets (workbook has sheets "Statistics"/"Gamma"/"9 points"/"5_13 points"; filename often like "<Model> ORDER x SCREEN CHECK vX.X.xlsx" or "<Model>亮度表.xlsx") into DCnRG_V2 data/*.json files, wires up the matching device YAML config, and runs the report pipeline. Use when the user hands over such an Excel file and wants a report generated.
